[list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused a sound effect to sound when a bullet made contact with Volt.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that summoned spirits during conversation in the third stage "Forest Noir".
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some ghosts to move while posing.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Once you have purchased an event, you can watch it as many times as you want.
[*] Press the button again to start the event without losing money.
[/list]

notes.title: Various additions
notes.content:
[h2]New stage "Ruins"[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/a7453733c16347afa0b6574172ffaf81d57b3f77.jpg[/img]
It can be entered by pressing the Y button (V key) from the stage select.
The Ruins stage has a difficulty level similar to the final stage of the main story.
Make sure to strengthen Tia and the spirits to take on the challenge.

[h2]New boss " Vampiress"[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/24615f66bc5d26f3f593e8e417ac6ef288b31dc1.jpg[/img]
Three vampire sisters await you at each of the three stages of the ruins.
Their beautiful images are included in the "Digital Art Book".

[h2]Points Shop[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/0a80be4bbbe3a3f9e479ec0b2e77d99345e9e39c.jpg[/img]
When you play in the ruins, you get "points" for defeating enemies.
You can get points even if you retire in the middle of a stage.
The accumulated points can be "exchanged" for money or Doll outfits.
Points can only be used in the Ruins menu.

[h2]New Event "Special Event"[/h2]
After viewing this event, you will be able to change the Doll's outfit on the home screen.

[h2]Home Screen Customization[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/36322e228f79e5ffdb0f1725103db495821b6d35.jpg[/img]
Once you have obtained a doll outfit in exchange for points, you can change the outfit with L(Q)/R(E) on the home screen.
Let's dress Doll in your favorite outfit.

[h2]New item "Explosive Mana Gem"[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/01425b4af1ec2a5d8dc6d8ecbfc8e5921b0c6f8f.jpg[/img]
The "Explosive Mana Gem" has been added to the alchemy room.
It can be used by holding down the B button (C key) on the stage.
When used, it deals 20 damage around Tia and makes her invincible for a short while.
During this time, You can safely enhance the spirits.
You can only have up to 3 magic stones. When used, it can be refilled as many times as needed.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Fixed a bug where the boss BGM could not be adjusted.

notes.title: Various adjustments
notes.content:
Doll's costume returned.

Added "Change avoid button" to the Pause menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/c7a03d36abcb85c5175bbd4b7eb4ad83be39ca50.jpg[/img]
Check this box to change from A button (X key) to B button (C key)

Fixed a large diagonal movement during evasion.

notes.title: Various adjustments
notes.content:
Returned the Doll's costume.
Fixed a bug where mana would not be recovered after breaking a Boundary Stone while on Maat.
Fixed a bug that prevented energy barrage from appearing after summoning three or more sprites.

notes.title: Various adjustments
notes.content:
Tia and Doll are Japanese kimono style on the home screen.(until 1/15)

Added "Sound Settings" and "Display Settings" to the stage pause menu.
Added keyboard input to the stage, player can use J,K,L,I, for actions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/b543b69799dc4681739b3985492b965cae2b8f37.png[/img]

Added color animation to enemy attack warnings.
Added a warning when the boss appears.

Fixed a bug where the queen would attack immediately after transforming.
Fixed a bug that could spawn a spirit before a conversation.

Fixed a misspell.

notes.title: Adjusted for inconvenience and unreasonable specifications
notes.content:
[h1]Purpose of the update[/h1]
Reviewed specifications that were inconvenient or unreasonable.

[list]
[*] In addition to the previous lunchbox rules, lunchboxes will now be automatically activated for the first stage.
[*] And increased the multiplier of streak bonus to make it "worth continuing to clear".
[*] When the game is over, player can choose "Retry" or "Return to Home".
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/c8362bd315b1b755d8d5da7a207df0d2120b1921.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Lowered the cost of sprites' energy shots a bit.
[*] Slightly lowered the cost of enhancing spirits.
[*] Tia's crosshairs can be rotated in three places with RB (E key).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/b4db0063fcd43c15cc5ae0f3efe84080f65c509a.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Lowered the HP of "Ore", "Mushroom", and "Fruit Tree" objects.
[*] Changed the position of the objects in some stages to make it easier to initially place the spirits.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/df1dc0d7868878a326c20377ef018d81ac7fae4a.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that the game speed to be multiplied by 1 after summondoll.
[*] Fixed some translations.
[/list]

I will keep updating the game to make it better!

notes.title: Difficulty has been adjusted.
notes.content:
[h1]Purpose of the update[/h1]
[list]
[*] To prevent instant deaths due to accidents in the tutorial
[*] Addressed the issue of enemies being too hard and difficult to defeat.
[*] Addressed the problem of enemies in STG stages that are difficult to defeat.
[*] To make it easier to get materials so that players don't have to play around too much
[/list]

Tia's hit range has been reduced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/9be2e01eb0b6b92db29b06d1b930dec4485db9ab.jpg[/img]
Tia's initial HP to 2.
Tia's movement speed has been increased a bit.

Increased the basic attack speed of Sylph, Fenrir, Bolt, and Shade.

Slows down the movement speed of Slime, Myconid, Shell, and Stone Eye.
HP of Bat, Hornet, and Harpy have been lowered  a bit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299343/c3e1722fad8aa0ffa9bfbefb15cfdf698d261b4a.jpg[/img]
Lowered the HP of the Siren sisters.
Reduced the number of enemies in shoot'em up stage.
Lowered the mana reduction speed of the shoot'em up stage.

Increased the number of material drops in the stage from 2 to 3

I' ll keep updating to make it more comfortable to play!

This is PicoGames.

[previewyoutube=CzA0uNFUieY;full][/previewyoutube]

When you raise the level of a genie in a stage, it gains additional abilities.
The video shows an example of a "sylph," whose additional ability is to "generate a low-probability ricochet that damages surrounding enemies.

With this specification
"Spend a large amount of money to make one spirit stronger."
"Spend a small amount of money to increase the number of spirits."
The choice is yours.
